game.name: Swing Beats
game.desc: Lofi drums over PCM with J Dilla-style swing: 5 tracks of 16 steps, per-track swing, groove templates, flam, phrase drift and humanize. Records its stem with a click count-in for mixing in a DAW. Part of swing_pico8 with swing_keys and swing_noise.

game.name: Swing Keys
game.desc: Bass, lead and chords written as scale degrees, with diatonic 7th chords, reverb, filter, detune, tape wobble and tempo-synced echo. Shares the song with swing_beats and swing_noise.

game.name: Swing Noise
game.desc: Lofi ambience over PCM: vinyl, tape, rain, fire, sea and night, with presets, kick-synced ducking, fades and needle drop. Shares the song with swing_beats and swing_keys.

game.name: Swing Mix
game.desc: Hear the whole song: plays the drums, keys and noise of swing_beats, swing_keys and swing_noise together, with level, mute and solo per stem. Can also record the mix with a click count-in.
